card.fires_on: Partway through the words inducers and inhibitors, or on inhibit/inhibitor, after enzyme or CYP names in drug interaction text. Also fires once on water in a list of metabolism products.

modes.label: Inducer/inhibitor stems
modes.description: The first piece of inducers or inhibitors after enzyme, CYP3A4, or strong/moderate.

modes.label: Inhibit as a verb or noun
modes.description: The word inhibit or inhibitor in sentences about drugs acting on CYP enzymes.
modes.example: Atazanavir is an<< inhibitor>> of CYP3A and UGT
